label: Strong supplementation is equivalent to the existing OverlapExtensionalParthood condition on the…
description: Strong supplementation gives the contrapositive of overlap inclusion implying parthood; transitivity supplies the forward implication. Conversely, if every part of x overlaps y, every overlap of x overlaps y through a common subpart, so existing overlap-extensional parthood gives x≤y. Classical contraposition yields a disjoint part. This is an equivalence, not unconditional strong supplementation.
